explanation: Fires only at GO and only late in the episode (timing baseline: ~0.13 in trials 80-89, ~0.56 in 90-99). Beyond timing, magnitude is largest (~2-3) at late GO steps after a common rewarded a1->S1 trial; rewarded a2->S1 (rare) also raises it, while unrewarded trials or S2 outcomes give near zero. The ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (belief_lo) adds a graded increase in the final decile. The free fit adds the rare-rewarded S1 case, a ramp with ep_trial within trials 90-99, generic prev-reward and reward two trials back; the short form captures ~81% of it on dev. Observed-only: no future or model-output terms.

issues: Running misses on the recorded short form shows a large systematic error. At late GO steps after unrewarded trials it predicts about 0.4 to 0.9, because the 0.56 decile-9 baseline is left in place, but the feature is actually 0. Biggest over-predictions: GO after a1 S2 u -0.087, a2 S2 u -0.076, a1 S1 u -0.051. The label says 'strongest after rewarded a1->S1' but never says it is essentially silent after any unrewarded trial.

The recorded form treats each decile as flat, but magnitude grows with ep_trial inside trials 80-99. Worst-fit windows show actual 2.4-2.9 against predicted 0.6-1.9, rising from about t93 to t99. A ramp term max(ep_trial-80,0) x (rewarded, reached S1) gives much higher test R^2 than the two decile step terms (0.738 vs 0.535).

The a1 restriction from last_is('a1 S1 r') is too narrow. Using 'previous trial rewarded and reached S1' with any choice scores better (test 0.554 vs 0.535 with the same structure). Under the recorded form, rare rewarded a2->S1 is the most under-predicted class (+0.076), and the first trial of a window (previous pattern '?') is also under-predicted.

Claims that hold up: GO-only (zero at D1/D2), late episode only, belief_lo adds a positive graded term (weight about +0.11), no future variables, no model outputs. Previous reward alone is not enough (test 0.40), so the reached state S1 matters.
